Cinderella / by Charles Perrault ; retold by Andy Prentice ; illustrated by Lorena Alvarez -- The Golden Goose / by the Brothers Grimm ; retold by Laura Cowan ; illustrated by Mike and Carl Gordon -- The Wizard of Oz / by L. Frank Baum ; adapted by Rosie Dickins ; illustrated by Davide Ortu -- The wind in the willows / by Kenneth Grahame ; adapted by Eddie Reynolds ; illustrated by Maura Evangelista -- The Snow Queen / by Hans Christian Andersen ; retold by Andy Prentice ; illustrated by Elena Selivanova -- The magic pear tree : a folk tale from China / retold by Rob Lloyd Jones ; illustrated by Matt Ward -- Sleeping Beauty / by Charles Perrault ; retold by Eddie Reynolds ; illustrated by Sara Gianassi -- The Magic Porridge Pot / by the Brothers Grimm ; retold by Rosie Dickins ; illustrated by Mike and Carl Gordon -- The Nutcracker / by E. T. A. Hoffmann ; retold by Rob Lloyd Jones ; illustrated by Anna Luraschi -- Alice's adventures in Wonderland / by Lewis Carroll ; adapted by Lesley Sims ; illustrated by Mauro Evangelista. Summary: Ten familiar tales, retold for young readers and gorgeously illustrated, including favourites Sleeping Beauty, Cinderella and The Magic Porridge Pot, as well as classics The Wind in the Willows and Alice in Wonderland. Ideal for sharing with younger children; as children learn to read, they can tackle these simple stories on their own.
